title: Data health
subtitle: Everything that might need a second look in {{family}}.
healthyDescription: No missing links or conflicting dates were found.

MISSING_PERSON.title: Connection points at a missing person
MISSING_PERSON.explanation: The link refers to someone who is no longer in this family. Remove the link.

CROSS_FAMILY.title: Connection crosses two families
CROSS_FAMILY.explanation: Both people in a connection must belong to the same family.

SELF_RELATIONSHIP.title: Person linked to themselves
SELF_RELATIONSHIP.explanation: A person cannot be their own parent, child or partner.

ANCESTRY_CYCLE.title: Circular ancestry
ANCESTRY_CYCLE.explanation: Someone ends up being their own ancestor. Check the parent links along this line.

CONFLICTING_DIRECTION.title: Parent and child are reversed somewhere
CONFLICTING_DIRECTION.explanation: The same pair is recorded as parent to child in both directions.

BIOLOGICALLY_IMPLAUSIBLE_DATE.title: Birth dates do not line up
BIOLOGICALLY_IMPLAUSIBLE_DATE.explanation: A parent is recorded as born too close to, or after, their child.

INVALID_DATE.title: Date cannot be read
INVALID_DATE.explanation: Use a year, year-month or full date, for example 1956-07-16.

DUPLICATE_RELATIONSHIP.title: Duplicate connection
DUPLICATE_RELATIONSHIP.explanation: The same connection is recorded more than once. Remove the extra one.

GENERATION_CONFLICT.title: Generations conflict
GENERATION_CONFLICT.explanation: This person appears in two different generations at once.

DISCONNECTED_PERSON.title: Not connected to anyone
DISCONNECTED_PERSON.explanation: This person has no parents, children or partners yet, so they float on their own.

UNKNOWN_GENDER.title: Gender not recorded
UNKNOWN_GENDER.explanation: Optional, but recording it makes the tree easier to read at a glance.

MISSING_GIVEN_NAMES.title: Given names missing
MISSING_GIVEN_NAMES.explanation: Add given names so this person can be identified in lists and on the tree.

MISSING_FAMILY_NAME.title: Family name missing
MISSING_FAMILY_NAME.explanation: Add a family name (last name) to complete this record.

MISSING_MAIDEN_NAME.title: Maiden name missing
MISSING_MAIDEN_NAME.explanation: Optional, but useful when tracing maternal lines.

MISSING_BIRTH_DATE.title: Birth date missing
MISSING_BIRTH_DATE.explanation: Add a birth year or full date to help place this person in time.

MISSING_DEATH_DATE.title: Death date missing
MISSING_DEATH_DATE.explanation: This person is marked deceased but has no death date.

MISSING_BIRTH_PLACE.title: Birth place missing
MISSING_BIRTH_PLACE.explanation: Optional location detail for this person.

MISSING_DEATH_PLACE.title: Death place missing
MISSING_DEATH_PLACE.explanation: Optional location detail for this person.

MISSING_LIVING_STATUS.title: Living status missing
MISSING_LIVING_STATUS.explanation: Record whether this person is living or deceased.

MISSING_NOTES.title: Notes missing
MISSING_NOTES.explanation: Optional free-text notes for this person.

fallback.title: Needs a look
fallback.explanation: Something about this record does not add up.
